title: (0Day) Microsoft GitHub Dev-Containers Improper Privilege Management Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Microsoft GitHub. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the configuration of Dev-Containers. The application does not enforce the privileged flag within a devcontainer configuration. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute code in the context of the host.
